title: JustEnoughItems issue #4351: [Bug]: UI error when opening inventory
licence: GitHub issue thread: user-generated content under the GitHub Terms of Service; the repo licence (MIT) does not cover issue text
text:
[issue by Syntrait]
### Steps to Reproduce the Bug

Hi, normally JEI works fine. However, when I downloaded the latest Paper 1.21.11 server jar file, ran it, and joined the server with only Fabric API and JEI installed, JEI had an error, causing the UI to not appear, even when pressed O, or Ctrl-O.

Strangely enough, JEI also stopped working on the server I normally play on, and it's the first time JEI failed like this.

JEI still works like normal on singleplayer.

I found similar issues on the issue tracker, but the error message this time is unique.

1. Download Paper 1.21.11 server JAR  # 132 from https://fill-ui.papermc.io/projects/paper/version/1.21.11
2. Create a new folder, and put the JAR file in it
3. Run the server with `java -jar paper-1.21.11-132.jar`
4. Set the eula to true
5. Run the server again
6. Connect to the server with Direct Connect with "localhost"
7. Open the inventory
8. Error


### Expected Behavior

JEI to not error out, and for the UI to appear, just as normal

### Actual Behavior

JEI goes through an error, and the UI never appears

### Extra Notes (Optional)

I have no clue why it's acting like this, because it worked just fine a few hours ago. I checked my system logs, and everything seems to be alright. I thought I ran out of free space, but no, I still have 12 GiB of free space.
I thought it might be COW (Copy-on-Write) corrupting data, so I created a new instance/profile, and only installed Fabric API and JEI. I also tried restarting the game multiple times. It's still happening.

I tried giving myself /op, setting myself to Creative mode, doing /recipe give @s *, but none of them helped.

The game does not crash, only the JEI UI does, so I can still play the game normally.

https://gist.github.com/Syntrait/41c04b9450d3e65c524d2ff8ae82b582

[comment by mezz (owner)]
Thanks for the report!
Can you please include the server log here as well?

[comment by mezz (owner)]
Please note that 
> Due to changes in the vanilla game, the recipes need to by synced from the server to the client using Fabric on the server.

https://github.com/mezz/JustEnoughItems/issues/4137#issuecomment-3480881947

This means JEI is required on the server too, or else it will not work.

[comment by Syntrait (none)]
the server log: https://gist.github.com/Syntrait/3da7b8f4b775892aaad6b8c7469b2c57

Alright, it looks like installing a mod like "Client Recipe Fix" that adds vanilla recipe fallbacks does make JEI not error out. It does error out java.lang.ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException without the mod, but it's not like JEI would have worked anyways without the mod installed on the server. It still does freeze the game for a second the first time opening the inventory.
